messages.subject: Caspian - completion bring-down call moved to Friday
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom - unrelated to Cryovance, but the Caspian Technologies completion bring-down call has moved to Friday 11am. Maya Patel wants the final funds-flow circulated 24 hours before. Can you make sure James has it in hand? Thanks. S

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
